fact: On 5 November 2025 the Ministry of Economy and Trade launched an electronic service within the commercial register system issuing a letter to the Foreign Ministry confirming a company's registration, available through the electronic system.
title: وزارة الاقتصاد والتجارة تطلق خدمة إصدار رسالة صحة قيد الشركة إلكترونياً
